#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>

// Read existing metadata only. Creating the directory would fabricate a creation date.
extern "C" int64_t RTE_ReadDocumentsCreationDate()
{
    @autoreleasepool
    {
        NSFileManager *manager = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
        NSURL *documents = [[manager URLsForDirectory:NSDocumentDirectory inDomains:NSUserDomainMask] firstObject];
        NSString *path = documents.path;
        if (path == nil) return -1;
        // Unity exports may disable Objective-C exceptions. Use Foundation's error result.
        NSError *error = nil;
        NSDictionary *attributes = [manager attributesOfItemAtPath:path error:&error];
        if (attributes == nil || error != nil) return -1;
        NSDate *created = attributes[NSFileCreationDate];
        if (![created isKindOfClass:[NSDate class]]) return -1;

        double milliseconds = floor([created timeIntervalSince1970] * 1000.0);
        double now = floor([[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970] * 1000.0);
        // Validate before conversion; invalid or future metadata is unknown, never "now".
        if (!isfinite(milliseconds) || milliseconds <= 0 || milliseconds >= (double)INT64_MAX || milliseconds > now)
            return -1;
        return (int64_t)milliseconds;
    }
}
